profiles.description: Syerleena Abdul Rashid represents Bukit Bendera, Pulau Pinang, in the Dewan Rakyat. A DAP member.

profiles.position: Deputy Minister of Women, Family and Community Development
profiles.description: Lim Hui Ying represents Tanjong, Pulau Pinang, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Deputy Minister of Women, Family and Community Development. A DAP member.

profiles.name: Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer
profiles.description: Sanisvara Nethaji Rayer represents Jelutong, Pulau Pinang, in the Dewan Rakyat. A DAP member.

milestones.title: Resurface the road and renew parking markings at Block 1, Taman Air Itam
milestones.description: Syerleena’s constituency allocation funded the road and parking works, including markings for 35 parking spaces.
milestones.progress_note: The delivery report states work ran from 20 April to 15 June 2026. Achieved covers only these completed works. No earlier public promise was established; September’s date is the evidence publication date.

milestones.title: Fund and hand over equipment and supporting assets for five clinics
milestones.description: The state health director confirmed Syerleena’s RM250,000 contribution was fully used in 2025 for five clinics and 160 assets.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved covers this documented contribution and handover, with health-department implementation credited. It does not attribute construction of the new clinic or wider health outcomes to the MP. No earlier promise date was verified.

milestones.title: Table the Senior Citizens Bill in early 2027
milestones.description: Lim Hui Ying said the ministry had moved the planned bill from October 2026 to early 2027 after consultations.
milestones.progress_note: The source was published on 5 October. Tabling and enactment are separate steps; neither was verified as completed. Early 2027 supplies no exact day, so the date field remains blank.

milestones.title: Seek additional welfare funding and direct support for unpaid caregivers in Budget 2027
milestones.description: Lim described proposals for more than RM168 million in additional funding, including support for the care sector.
milestones.progress_note: A proposal is not an approved allocation or a payment. The reviewed report does not verify adoption or disbursement; outcome and percentage remain unknown.

methodology: Editorial records of dated public commitments, documented activities and delivery reports. Evidence-only activities and deliveries have no invented earlier promise URL or promise date. Status and numerical progress refer to the dated evidence, not a live performance rating. Joint government, constituency, party and agency roles are identified. Unknown outcomes remain NULL. Additional research may extend the initial pass.
